COLLECTOR-COLLECTED_PILE.title: Collected Pile
COLLECTOR-COLLECTED_PILE.description: This contains the Collected cards you have yet to draw this combat. You draw one card from this at the start of your turn.
COLLECTOR-KINDLE.title: Kindle
COLLECTOR-KINDLE.description: Summon a [gold]Torchhead[/gold]. If one is already summoned, increase its Max HP for this combat.
COLLECTOR-RESERVE.title: Reserve
COLLECTOR-RESERVE.description:
Reserve is used to play cards from your [gold]Hand[/gold] after [gold]Energy[/gold] runs out.
Stays between turns.
